# FreeSampler <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
FreeSampler:Void sampler:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sampler` | In | Int32 | required | The sampler to delete. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Deletes a sampler. The textures that read through it go back to the settings of their flags. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals read every texture with the settings of its flags and do not have samplers.
